message: Last summer, we had an unexpected blackout that lasted for hours. I felt a little smug as I pulled out my trusty lantern and charged my phone with a power bank, while my neighbors were scrambling for candles and flashlights. It’s funny how being prepared can turn a hassle into a cozy family night with board games and stories. Next time the lights go out, I’ll be ready again — and maybe I'll share some tips with my neighbors. How do you keep the mood light during a power outage?
